tools.name: get_bar_forces
tools.title: Get bar internal forces
tools.description: Extracts internal forces (FX, FY, FZ, MX, MY, MZ) along a specified bar at N relative points (0.0 = start, 1.0 = end). [Registry tool v1, Results, transaction=none. Registry tools run stored, reviewed C# inside Robot Structural Analysis — prefer them over execute_robot_code for the same task.]

barNumber.description: Bar number to extract forces for.

pointsCount.description: Number of calculation points along the bar length.

tools.name: get_coordinate_systems_and_grids
tools.title: Get coordinate systems and structural grids
tools.description: Reads defined structural axis grids (Cartesian, Cylindrical) including sequence coordinates, labels, and storey inclusions. [Registry tool v1, Geometry, transaction=none. Registry tools run stored, reviewed C# inside Robot Structural Analysis — prefer them over execute_robot_code for the same task.]

annotations.title: Get coordinate systems and structural grids

tools.name: assign_bar_section
tools.title: Assign bar section
tools.description: Assigns a defined cross-section profile to specified bars in the Robot model. [Registry tool v1, Property, transaction=auto. Registry tools run stored, reviewed C# inside Robot Structural Analysis — prefer them over execute_robot_code for the same task.]

sectionName.description: Name of the section to assign (e.g. 'IPE 300', 'HEA 200').

dryRun.description: Run the tool, then roll everything back. Use first on a model you care about.

tools.name: execute_robot_code
tools.title: Execute C# in Robot
tools.description: Runs a C# script against the Robot Structural Analysis Professional 2026 model the HPRobot MCP Bridge app is attached to (RobotOM API). Globals: robot (IRobotApplication), structure (IRobotStructure), units (IRobotUnitMngr; metric m, kN, kN·m, MPa enforced during run), ct, log(string), progress(cur,total,msg), args (args.Str/Int/Double/Bool). Robot has no transaction or undo API. Tiers decided statically: R read-only (Get*/Is*/Has*/Count/Find*/Exist/Query; transaction=none; no snapshot). W write (Create/Add*/SetLabel*/SetValue*/Store*/Update; transaction=auto; bridge saves model and copies a .rtd snapshot first; unsaved models are refused; rolledBack:false means changes persisted). D destructive/heavy (Calculate, Delete*, project.New/Open/Close/SaveAs): needs 'Allow heavy/destructive operations' in HPRobot MCP Bridge window, else error -32001; up to 300 s. dryRun or transaction=none on a writing script = static preview (nothing runs; PREVIEW diagnostic lists called members). cancel/timeout cannot interrupt a running Robot calculation solver call. No Quit/ApplicationExit/Interactive/MessageBox/Process/#r/#load. Needs 'Allow AI code execution' in the HPRobot MCP Bridge window.

code.description: C# script body, max 32 KB. Globals: robot (IRobotApplication), structure (IRobotStructure), units, args, ct, log, progress. No await, no System.IO/Net, no Quit/dialogs/#r/#load.

transaction.description: auto (default): writing script — bridge saves model and takes a .rtd snapshot before running. none: read-only; writing script is refused with a PREVIEW diagnostic. manual: behaves like auto.

dryRun.description: Static preview for a writing script (nothing runs; PREVIEW diagnostic lists what would be called); read-only scripts run normally. Refused for destructive members.

timeoutSeconds.description: Cooperative timeout in seconds, 5–120 (up to 300 while heavy operations are allowed). Checked between calls; a running Calculate solver cannot be interrupted.

label.description: Short name for the audit log and snapshot file name. Max 64 characters; letters, digits, _ and - survive, the rest becomes _.

args.description: Optional JSON object handed to the script as `args` (e.g. {"nodeNumber": 1, "section": "HEA 200"}). Keys are matched case-insensitively.

tools.name: manage_tool
tools.title: Deprecate, quarantine or restore a tool
tools.description: deprecate: retire a tool (never runs again until restored). quarantine: pull it from tools/list. restore: back to draft so it can be tested and published again.

annotations.title: Deprecate, quarantine or restore a tool

tools.name: assign_node_support
tools.title: Assign node support
tools.description: Assigns support conditions (boundary restraints) to specified node numbers. Supports standard types (Fixed, Pinned, Roller) or named support labels. [Registry tool v1, Geometry, transaction=auto. Registry tools run stored, reviewed C# inside Robot Structural Analysis — prefer them over execute_robot_code for the same task.]

dryRun.description: Run the tool, then roll everything back. Use first on a model you care about.

tools.name: get_run
tools.title: Get a past run
tools.description: Details of one run from the history (runId comes back from the execute tool, run_tool and test_tool): outcome, args, the code when it was a successful ad-hoc script, and — when the host application is reachable — an analysis listing hard-coded literals (line, value, variable) and the args keys already read. Use it before propose_tool to decide which literals become parameters.

analyze.description: Analyse the code (guard, compile, literals) through the host application

tools.name: inspect_type
tools.title: Inspect a host API type
tools.description: Reflects over an API type loaded in the running host application (Revit or AutoCAD) and returns its public members as C#-like signatures (kind: property | method | field | event). Use it to confirm exact method names and parameters before writing a script.

typeName.description: Type name, e.g. 'Wall' or 'FilteredElementCollector' in Revit, 'Polyline' or 'LayerTableRecord' in AutoCAD, or a fully qualified name such as 'Autodesk.Revit.DB.Structure.Rebar'.

memberFilter.description: Optional case-insensitive substring to keep only matching member names, e.g. 'Create'.

maxMembers.description: Maximum number of members to return (default 100, max 500).

tools.name: get_structural_objects
tools.title: Get structural objects
tools.description: Extracts structural nodes, bars, and panels with coordinates, connectivity, assigned sections, and materials. Supports filtering by object type and limit. [Registry tool v1, Geometry, transaction=none. Registry tools run stored, reviewed C# inside Robot Structural Analysis — prefer them over execute_robot_code for the same task.]

objectType.description: Category of structural elements to query.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return per category.

tools.name: draw_bar_by_coords
tools.title: Draw bar by coordinates
tools.description: Creates a structural bar between start and end 3D coordinates (meters). Automatically creates or connects existing nodes at the endpoints and optionally assigns a cross-section. [Registry tool v1, Geometry, transaction=auto. Registry tools run stored, reviewed C# inside Robot Structural Analysis — prefer them over execute_robot_code for the same task.]

barNumber.description: Optional bar number. If 0 or omitted, next free number is used.

dryRun.description: Run the tool, then roll everything back. Use first on a model you care about.

tools.name: assign_bar_load
tools.title: Assign bar load
tools.description: Applies a uniform or concentrated force load to structural bars in a specified load case. Uses metric units (kN/m for uniform, kN for concentrated). [Registry tool v1, Load, transaction=auto. Registry tools run stored, reviewed C# inside Robot Structural Analysis — prefer them over execute_robot_code for the same task.]

pz.description: Load intensity in Z direction (kN/m or kN). Negative value indicates downwards.

relativePosition.description: Relative position along bar (0.0 to 1.0) for concentrated loads.

isLocal.description: Whether coordinates are in local bar system instead of global.

dryRun.description: Run the tool, then roll everything back. Use first on a model you care about.

tools.name: publish_tool
tools.title: Publish a registry tool
tools.description: Request publication of a tested tool. Policy manual (default): the tool becomes pending_approval, a review file is written and a human must run the server's `registry approve <name>` command (`<server>.exe registry --help`; or set status=published in tool.json). Policy auto: tested tools publish immediately. Published tools appear in tools/list of every running server.

tools.name: get_node_reactions
tools.title: Get node reactions
tools.description: Extracts support reaction forces (FX, FY, FZ) and moments (MX, MY, MZ) for specified nodes and load case/combination. [Registry tool v1, Results, transaction=none. Registry tools run stored, reviewed C# inside Robot Structural Analysis — prefer them over execute_robot_code for the same task.]

tools.name: search_tools
tools.title: Search the tool registry
tools.description: Search the registry of stored tools for this host (Revit or AutoCAD) BEFORE writing code with the execute tool (execute_revit_code / execute_autocad_code). Full-text over name, description, tags and examples, ranked by relevance × stability × status. Returns each tool's inputSchema so it can be called directly by name (published tools are real MCP tools) or through run_tool. Empty query lists tools (optionally by category).

query.description: What you want to do, in any language, e.g. 'tạo lưới trục', 'color beams by type', 'room schedule'

category.description: One of the host's categories (search_tools lists them): Architecture | Structure | MEP | Annotation | View | Data | Generic for Revit, Drawing | Layer | Block | Annotation | Layout | Data | Generic for AutoCAD

includeUnpublished.description: Also return draft / tested / pending tools (they need allowUnpublished=true in run_tool)

tools.name: cancel_execution
tools.title: Cancel running script
tools.description: Signals cancellation to the script currently running in the host application. Cancellation is cooperative: the script stops at its next `ct` check, and its transaction group is rolled back. Returns whether anything was running.

tools.name: get_model_info
tools.title: Get model info
tools.description: Returns an overview of the active Robot Structural Analysis model: file path, project type, node/bar/panel counts, load case counts, calculation status, and active units. Read-only. [Registry tool v1, Model, transaction=none. Registry tools run stored, reviewed C# inside Robot Structural Analysis — prefer them over execute_robot_code for the same task.]

includeCases.description: Include summary list of load cases and combinations.

tools.name: get_tool
tools.title: Get a registry tool
tools.description: Full record of one stored tool: metadata, input schema, examples, C# code (optional), run statistics and recent runs.

recentRuns.description: How many recent runs to include (0–50)

tools.name: run_calculations
tools.title: Run calculations
tools.description: Generates the computational FEA model and executes structural calculations. Heavy/Destructive operation requiring AllowHeavyOperations toggle. [Registry tool v1, Analysis, transaction=auto. Registry tools run stored, reviewed C# inside Robot Structural Analysis — prefer them over execute_robot_code for the same task.]

autoGenerateModel.description: Automatically regenerate mesh/computational model before solver execution.

dryRun.description: Run the tool, then roll everything back. Use first on a model you care about.

tools.name: get_robot_context
tools.title: Get Robot context
tools.description: Returns the Robot Structural Analysis session the bridge app is attached to: hostVersion (2026), docTitle and docPath of the model file (.rtd), isModifiable (attached and idle), executionEnabled, and robot info {isAttached, attachedPid, robotVersion, structureType, isCalculated, heavyOperationsEnabled, nodeCount, barCount, panelCount, loadCaseCount}. With includeSelection=true returns selected nodes, bars, and panels. Call this before execute_robot_code to verify model state and calculation readiness.

includeSelection.description: Include current selection (selected nodes, bars, and panels).

tools.name: get_load_definitions
tools.title: Get load definitions
tools.description: Reads all load cases (simple cases, dead, live, wind, seismic) and combinations with applied records count and factor definitions. [Registry tool v1, Load, transaction=none. Registry tools run stored, reviewed C# inside Robot Structural Analysis — prefer them over execute_robot_code for the same task.]

includeRecords.description: If true, extracts details for each load record inside the cases.

tools.name: get_materials_and_sections
tools.title: Get materials and sections
tools.description: Lists all defined materials and bar cross-sections in the active Robot model with their engineering properties (E, G, density, area, moments of inertia). [Registry tool v1, Property, transaction=none. Registry tools run stored, reviewed C# inside Robot Structural Analysis — prefer them over execute_robot_code for the same task.]

tools.name: run_tool
tools.title: Run a registry tool
tools.description: Run a stored tool from the registry with the given args (must match its inputSchema from search_tools / get_tool). Same result shape as the execute tool. Draft / tested / pending tools need allowUnpublished=true. Use dryRun=true first for tools that modify the document.

allowUnpublished.description: Allow running a tool that is not published yet

tools.name: propose_tool
tools.title: Propose a new registry tool
tools.description: Package a working C# script as a reusable tool (status draft). Replace every literal that may change between calls with args.<Kind>("key") and declare each key in inputSchema (JSON Schema object: string/number/integer/boolean/array/object, required, default, description). The code is guard-checked and compiled inside the host application but not run. Give ≥ 2 examples with different args; test_tool runs them. Returns a validation report; fix errors and call again. Use newVersion=true to replace the code of an existing tool.

description.description: What the tool does, for search and for the reviewer (≥ 20 chars)

category.description: One of the host's categories (search_tools lists them): Architecture | Structure | MEP | Annotation | View | Data | Generic for Revit, Drawing | Layer | Block | Annotation | Layout | Data | Generic for AutoCAD

inputSchema.description: JSON Schema of the args object

code.description: Script body: same globals as the execute tool plus args; must end with return

title.description: Human title, e.g. 'Colour beams by type'

transaction.description: auto (the bridge wraps the run in a transaction) | manual (Revit: the code opens its own Transaction; AutoCAD: same as auto) | none (read-only)

sourceRunId.description: runId of the execute run this comes from (see get_run)

newVersion.description: Propose a new version of an existing tool name

tools.name: test_tool
tools.title: Test a registry tool
tools.description: Run a tool's examples (or the given cases) inside the host application with dryRun — every change is rolled back — and record the outcomes. All cases passing moves a draft to tested. realRun=true commits the changes (only on a scratch model).

cases.description: Optional cases [{"title": "...", "args": {...}}]; default = the tool's examples
